serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Sustainment Digital Manufacturing Hub (DMH) is a cloud-based supplier discovery and market research platform that helps government agencies identify, evaluate, and connect with qualified U.S. manufacturing suppliers. DMH provides AI-driven supplier intelligence, including capabilities data, certifications, machine and process information, and past performance context. Our platform enables acquisition teams, program offices, and sourcing specialists to conduct market research and strengthen the defense industrial base. DMH is the government enclave of the Sustainment platform, purpose-built for federal security and compliance requirements.
